**LaküenPlay v1.0 – PC** is the first versioned release of this performance-focused Linux fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) **build 130**, built for desktop Linux and SteamOS PCs.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is an unofficial fork, not an official Lichii release. Please report problems [here](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/Lichii_improvments_ram/issues), not upstream. Games, keys and firmware are not included: only use content you have legally obtained.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.0-PC-x86_64-pgo.AppImage` | **Recommended.** Self-contained, compiled with profile-guided optimization |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.0-PC-x86_64.AppImage` | The same program without PGO, for comparison |
| `*.tar.gz` | Plain binaries that use your system libraries (Qt 6 and friends must be installed) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

**Getting started:** make the AppImage executable (`chmod +x LakuenPlay-*.AppImage`) and run it. On SteamOS you can add it to Steam as a non-Steam game. The AppImage needs glibc 2.39 or newer: SteamOS 3.7+, Ubuntu 24.04+, Fedora 40+, Debian 13, Arch.

LaküenPlay uses **the same data folders and settings as Lichii**, so saves, keys and shader caches carry over. Back up your saves before trying experimental builds.

## What's new compared to Lichii build 130

### Performance
- **Split GPU thread with far fewer stalls** ([Lichii #1161](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1161)): semaphore acquires don't drain the split, more delta "fast draws", cheaper reports.
- **More fast draws:** `vertex_id_base`, counter resets, render-enable and per-draw reports no longer force a full draw setup.
- **Fewer GPU submits:** empty command buffers are no longer submitted.
- **Faster JIT:** dynarmic's IR verification pass is skipped.
- **Per-thread GPU page translation cache**, and faster translation of large compute shaders.
- **PGO build** with a profile recorded on a Ryzen 7 5800X3D / Radeon RX 6600 XT under SteamOS.

### Memory
- **All-zero guest pages and freed heap are returned to the system** on Linux.
- **The pipeline cache keeps what it built:** its budget scales with video memory, and pipelines stay much longer before eviction ([#1107](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1107)). Less rebuild stutter when you return to an area.
- **Uneven-mip ASTC textures stay BC-compressed on AMD** instead of 4–8× larger RGBA8 ([#1194](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1194)).
- **Integrated GPUs no longer stay in the texture cache's emergency mode** ([#823](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/823)).
- **At most 4 shader workers** on PCs with 16 GB of RAM or less.

### AMD / RADV stability
- **Task/mesh draws use the compute fallback on RADV by default.** Native mesh shaders hang RDNA2 GPUs ([#871](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/871)).
- **Robust buffer access and bounds-checked texture decodes** against device-lost errors. A limit on shader compare-exchange loops against GPU hangs.
- **Task/mesh pipelines are built without the driver's optimizer on AMD**, for sane compile times.
- **The occlusion-query copy waits only on the newest query on RADV.**

### Fixes ported from newer Lichii
- **No freeze while a compute pipeline is rebuilt** ([#969](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/969)).
- **Evicted pipelines keep their storage-buffer pointers** ([#1143](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1143), [#1154](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1154)).
- **Destroyed guest memory releases its GPU ranges**, and reused device ranges map current pages ([#1199](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1199), [#1221](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1221)).
- **Lock-order deadlock fixes** in the GPU memory registry ([#1218](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1218)).
- **No UI freeze when closing a stuck game** ([#1234](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1234)).
- **No ADPCM audio crackle** ([#1196](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1196)).

Almost every new behaviour can be switched off with an environment variable for comparison. The full list is in the [README](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/Lichii_improvments_ram#environment-switches).

<summary><b>Deutsch – Kurzfassung</b></summary>

**LaküenPlay v1.0 – PC** ist die erste feste Version dieses Linux-Forks von Lichii Build 130 für Desktop-PCs und SteamOS.

- **Empfohlen:** `LakuenPlay-v1.0-PC-x86_64-pgo.AppImage`. Ausführbar machen (`chmod +x`) und starten.
- **Neu:**
  - weniger Wartezeiten im GPU-Thread (#1161), mehr schnelle Zeichenbefehle, weniger leere GPU-Übergaben
  - weniger RAM-Verbrauch (Null-Seiten und freier Heap gehen zurück ans System, ASTC bleibt auf AMD komprimiert)
  - Pipelines bleiben länger im Speicher (#1107), also weniger Nachlade-Ruckler
  - Stabilitäts-Fixes für AMD/RADV
  - übernommene Fixes aus neueren Lichii-Versionen
- **Daten:** gleiche Ordner und Einstellungen wie Lichii.
- **Probleme** bitte hier melden, nicht bei Lichii.

</details>
